items.title: Cyber Armor 2.0
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
The cyber armors have been upgraded and are ready for more! You'll catch everyone's attention while wearing these armor sets!

- 8 unique skins!
- Loads of different designs and colors so you can pick the skin that suits you!

items.title: Steampunk Force
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
As the engines churn and the smoke bellows, the steam force gathers as the ultimate PvP team! It's time to slide on your goggles and let off some steam with your friends as you roleplay with these steampunk inspired skins!

- 10 skins!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Trendy Squad 2021
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
Summer is here and it is time to party! Put on these trendy outfits and have a crazy summer with your squad! Unleash your true personality with these trendy outfits!

Also perfect for PvP and PvE!

+ 25 Trendy Squad Skins

items.title: Climate Futures
items.creator: Minecraft
items.description: Climate Futures takes you on a journey through time to view the effects of deforestation and solutions that can create a more sustainable future for us all. Talk to construction workers, scientists from the future, and even forest animals to learn about climate change. Create new blocks from recycled materials and build solutions to make a change for the better!

items.title: Horse Friends
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Are you ready to trollop and parkour around your awesome Minecraft builds with these adorable teen horse skins?
* 21 HD skins!

items.title: High School Cats
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
These high school animal teen skins are perfect for roleplay and adventure. 
* 36 awesome skins!

items.title: Animatronics Fear Factor
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Prepare yourself for some creepy and scary characters! Nothing is as it seems! Oh, and always look behind you!
* Perfect for the ultimate jump scares!

items.title: Backyard Droppers
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Are you ready to free your mind, fall from the sky and try these relaxing and fun summer droppers? Please don't get hurt trying! 
* 13 fun dropper levels!
* Multiplayer friendly!
* Great for killing a little free time! 
By Giggle Block Studios!

items.title: Mash Mobs
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
A mad scientist took mobs and slammed them together! These crazy mashed mobs are sure to draw heads. Check out the Pigman Creeper, the Golem Squid, or the Zombie Chicken!

+ 12 unique mashed mobs for you to choose from!

items.title: Bees are the Best
items.creator: Arrow Art Games
items.description: So many bees of different types: happy, angry, small, large, glitter, and a bonus tiger lily and sunflower skin are featured in this Minecraft skin pack. Watch out for angry glitter bee, it’s the only one with a stinger. Blend in on a farm or stand out against a space backdrop. Bees are the BEST. All skins are HD.

items.title: Furniture : Summer Expansion
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Spend your summer in a huge, modern oceanside city. Meet plenty of friendly neighbors. The best part? You get to design and decorate your dream house/mansion/condo with tons of furniture, props and tools.

+1000 furniture design options
+500 wearable combinations
+70 HD skins
+Animated, working props
+Dress up your interactive neighbors
+Perfect to role-play with friends

items.title: Cyber Armor
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Charge up and head out with the latest cyber-tech gear! You'll catch everyone's attention with wearing these armor sets!

- 8 unique skins!
- Loads of different designs and colors so you can pick the skin that suits you!

items.title: Blingy Neko
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Hop in the most comfortable clothes and have a great time with your best friends! If you love luxury and anime, then this pack is suitable for you! Try on the trendiest costumes and dive into a new dimension full of exciting experiences. Be the best version of yourself while having fun! Turn your blingy style on!

+ 1 free skin
+ 11 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Prehistoric Textures
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Step back in time when humans were still living in caves. Prehistoric Minecraft brings new life to your world. With a colorful and vibrant look, this pack will make you feel like you stepped back in time. Play survival solo or with friends with a new fresh look with that old world feeling.

+ Made for 1.16
+ 3 boy and 3 girl skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Mega Find the Button
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
From mazes to parkour and many other fun challenges, this puzzle map has it all! With 50 awesome grid cubes, you can explore biomes, modern houses, and more by finding each button to move on to the next adventure. Will you be the next puzzle champion?

- 4 teen skins
- 50 rooms
- For everyone
- Multiplayer friendly

items.title: Parkour Honeycomb
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Parkour Honeycomb is a parkour map that takes you through multiple stages of the game as you traverse through your environment to reach the end! Are you able to make it through all 49 levels? Attempt it with your friends or brave it alone!

+ 7 stages
+ 49 levels
+ Great for beginners and pros
+ By ArgoStudios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Parkour Ore Tower
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Do you have what it takes to climb the tower? Parkour Ore Tower is a parkour challenge featuring unique ore-themed levels!

- Unique ore-themed levels
- Respawn bed checkpoints!
- Playable with friends!
- Replayable!

items.title: Zodiac Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Which skin were you born for?

*12 zodiac teens

items.title: Mob Punks

items.description:
These mobs are too cool too follow the rules! 

*12 mob punks

items.title: Biome Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Adventure the world, and explore the dimensions with these cool biome teens!

*12 biome teens
*2 skins free

items.title: Teen Rebellion
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Jump off the beaten path and away from the mainstream trends! These rebellious teens are here to show off just how unique they are, will you join them?

- Includes 12 Unique Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: K-pop Teens
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
You just can't get away from the stage and even want to be Famous in the whole world? Then choose your optimal fashion style and feel free to be who you are.

+ K-pop
+ Singer
+ 10 different skins
+ 1 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: City Jobs
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
What is your dream job? Choose from 10 different jobs and life your dream alone or with your friends in the big city.

+ Police officer
+ Firefighter
+ Chef
+ Teacher
+ Doctor 
+ 1 free skin
and more!

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Speed Squads
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Racers get ready! set! GO!
Race on teams with your friends, or cruise the city streets in your favorite color.
Red, yellow, blue and green. 24 speedy skins to choose from.
The road is yours to adventure!
